headline: Ember Forge Awakening: Forge & Flame Update
summary: Telemetry shows strong activity in the Ember Forge and Whispering Fen routes. Based on feedback from the Beta Council, we are enhancing combat tension on high-difficulty paths and introducing a temporary marketplace coin bonus experiment to support progression toward elite cosmetics.

development_focus.title: Combat & Economy Optimization
development_focus.reason: Address combat challenger feedback on higher difficulty routes while easing the coin threshold gap for long-term cosmetics.

experiment.reason: Test an increased coin yield on Ember Forge to help bridge the mid-game currency gap for players saving toward elite crown items.

challenge.title: Forge Master's Trial
challenge.description: Navigate the hazards of Ember Forge and secure valuable ash and iron artifacts.

content_pack.title: Magma Vent Pressure
content_pack.description: Hot plates in the Ember Forge flare with increased frequency, requiring careful timing and mastery of movement.

development_backlog.title: Elite Enemy Behavior Profiles for Difficulty 3+ Routes
development_backlog.reason: Combat challengers reported low enemy encounter density and mechanical friction on high-tier routes.

development_backlog.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
development_backlog.reason: Explorers and collectors desire an in-game tracking interface for unique route items and completion rewards.

development_backlog.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
development_backlog.reason: First-time players need welcome tooltips at step 0 to understand initial movement and combat mechanics.

development_backlog.title: High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States
development_backlog.reason: Accessibility council noted that marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.

development_backlog.title: Movement Command Validation & Obstacle Input Buffering
development_backlog.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows redundant walk commands attempting to queue against active hazard collisions.
